entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: An immense forest in the interior of the continent of Tazeem on Zendikar, growing on reef-like rock formations.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar containing Oran-Rief.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Oran-Rief lies.

entities.name: Umara Skyfalls
entities.description: Waterfalls that descend from the skies above Oran-Rief.

entities.name: Umara River
entities.description: A river sourced from the Umara Skyfalls that nourishes the forest.

entities.name: Em's Blessing
entities.description: The rapid and explosive plant growth that responds to scarce sunlight in Oran-Rief.

entities.name: Eldrazi invasion
entities.description: The invasion by the Eldrazi that ravaged much of Zendikar.

events.summary: Oran-Rief and its reef-rock foundations are severely devastated during the Eldrazi invasion of Zendikar.
events.quote: The forest and its reef-rock foundations suffered severe devastation during the Eldrazi invasion

events.summary: After the Eldrazi titans are defeated, Oran-Rief rapidly recovers.
events.quote: Oran-Rief has been in a state of rapid recovery

relations.note: It stretches across much of Tazeem's interior.
relations.quote: Oran-Rief stretches across much of Tazeem's interior

relations.note: The Skyfalls are the source of the river.
relations.quote: The Skyfalls serve as the source of the Umara River
